sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-15 20:30 and 2016-11-22 16:11, 2 transaction(s) totalling $187.33 were made on card(s) C13487-K1 belonging to customer C13487. The activity comprised 2 online transaction(s) under product code(s) C, in billing region 191. Online transactions came from device profile(s) SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080. All came from device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080, marked New for every account, behind a proxy (anonymous). That device was used on 20 cards of 20 customers within 30 days, which no legitimate cardholder explains (policy R6). Total suspicious amount: $187.33. Actions recommended: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
